hypothesis: Equal averaging of independently fine-tuned seeds reduces prediction variance without tuning ensemble weights.
recipe: resnet18, ImageNet, CLAHE, mild augmentation, 16 epochs maximum, patience 5, LR 0.0005
combination: Arithmetic mean of three class probability vectors; weights fixed at 1/3
candidate_selection: Compare only fixed ensemble against incumbent; maximum validation specificity at recall >=0.98 then F1. Individual new seeds are not additional candidates.
test_policy: Evaluate locked winner only; incumbent win reuses existing test evidence. No external retuning.
prior_exposure: Legacy pediatric test and RSNA external v1 have been observed. Further claims on either are exploratory, not untouched external validation.
